views.definition: select `pc`.`product_ID` AS `ID`,`p`.`name` AS `product_name`,`c`.`name` AS `category_name`,`pc`.`status` AS `status`,`l`.`db_user` AS `inserted_by`,(select `r`.`FROM_USER` from `mysql`.`role_edges` `r` where (`r`.`TO_USER` = substring_index(`l`.`db_user`,'@',1)) limit 1) AS `roles`,`l`.`table_description` AS `table_description`,`l`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date` from (((`db_test`.`tbd_products_categories` `pc` join `db_test`.`tb_products` `p` on((`pc`.`product_ID` = `p`.`id`))) join `db_test`.`tb_categories` `c` on((`pc`.`category_ID` = `c`.`id`))) join `db_test`.`tb_logs` `l` on(((`l`.`table_name` = 'tbd_products_categories') and (`l`.`table_description` like concat('%ID=',`pc`.`product_ID`,', Category_ID=',`pc`.`category_ID`,'%')))))

views.definition: select `p`.`id` AS `id`,`p`.`SKU` AS `sku`,`p`.`name` AS `name`,`p`.`description` AS `description`,`p`.`current_price` AS `current_price`,`p`.`current_stock` AS `current_stock`,`p`.`status` AS `status`,coalesce(`l`.`db_user`,'Sin registro') AS `inserted_by`,coalesce(group_concat(distinct `re`.`FROM_USER` order by `re`.`FROM_USER` ASC separator ', '),'Sin rol') AS `roles`,coalesce(`l`.`table_description`,'Sin registro') AS `operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date` from ((`db_test`.`tb_products` `p` left join (select `db_test`.`tb_logs`.`db_user` AS `db_user`,`db_test`.`tb_logs`.`table_description` AS `table_description`,`db_test`.`tb_logs`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date`,cast(regexp_substr(`db_test`.`tb_logs`.`table_description`,'[0-9]+') as unsigned) AS `target_id` from `db_test`.`tb_logs` where ((`db_test`.`tb_logs`.`table_name` = 'tb_products') and (`db_test`.`tb_logs`.`table_operation` in ('Create','INSERT')))) `l` on((`p`.`id` = `l`.`target_id`))) left join `mysql`.`role_edges` `re` on((lower(`re`.`TO_USER`) = lower(substring_index(`l`.`db_user`,'@',1))))) group by `p`.`id`,`p`.`SKU`,`p`.`name`,`p`.`description`,`p`.`current_price`,`p`.`current_stock`,`p`.`status`,`l`.`db_user`,`l`.`table_description`,`l`.`operation_date`
